verses.original: γὰρ ὁ νόμος ἔχων Σκιὰν τῶν ἀγαθῶν μελλόντων οὐκ τὴν εἰκόνα τῶν πραγμάτων αὐτὴν δύναται οὐδέποτε ταῖς αὐταῖς θυσίαις εἰς τὸ ἃς προσφέρουσιν διηνεκὲς κατ’ ἐνιαυτὸν τελειῶσαι τοὺς προσερχομένους
verses.transliteration: gar ho nomos echōn Skian tōn agathōn mellontōn ouk tēn eikona tōn pragmatōn autēn dynatai oudepote tais autais thysiais eis to has prospherousin diēnekes kat’ eniauton teleiōsai tous proserchomenous
verses.literal: For the law is only a shadow of the good things to come not the realities . . . . . . themselves It can never by the same sacrifices vvv vvv - offered vvv vvv year after year make perfect those who draw near [ to worship ]

verses.original: ἐπεὶ ἂν οὐκ ἐπαύσαντο προσφερόμεναι διὰ τοὺς λατρεύοντας κεκαθαρισμένους ἅπαξ τὸ ἔχειν μηδεμίαν ἔτι συνείδησιν ἁμαρτιῶν
verses.transliteration: epei an ouk epausanto prospheromenai dia tous latreuontas kekatharismenous hapax to echein mēdemian eti syneidēsin hamartiōn
verses.literal: [If it could] . . . vvv would not the offerings have ceased . . . For the worshipers would have been cleansed once [for all] - [and] would no longer have felt the guilt of [their] sins

verses.original: Ἀλλ’ ἐν αὐταῖς κατ’ ἐνιαυτόν ἀνάμνησις ἁμαρτιῶν
verses.transliteration: All’ en autais kat’ eniauton anamnēsis hamartiōn
verses.literal: Instead - those [sacrifices] [are] an annual . . . reminder of sins

verses.original: γὰρ ἀδύνατον αἷμα ταύρων καὶ τράγων ἀφαιρεῖν ἁμαρτίας
verses.transliteration: gar adynaton haima taurōn kai tragōn aphairein hamartias
verses.literal: because [it is] impossible [for the] blood of bulls and goats to take away sins

verses.original: Διὸ εἰσερχόμενος εἰς τὸν κόσμον λέγει Θυσίαν καὶ προσφορὰν οὐκ ἠθέλησας δὲ Σῶμα κατηρτίσω μοι
verses.transliteration: Dio eiserchomenos eis ton kosmon legei Thysian kai prosphoran ouk ēthelēsas de Sōma katērtisō moi
verses.literal: Therefore when [Christ] came into the world He said Sacrifice and offering vvv You did not desire but a body You prepared for Me

verses.original: Ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ περὶ ἁμαρτίας Οὐκ εὐδόκησας
verses.transliteration: Holokautōmata kai peri hamartias Ouk eudokēsas
verses.literal: In burnt offerings and vvv sin [offerings] vvv You took no delight

verses.original: Τότε εἶπον Ἰδοὺ γέγραπται περὶ ἐμοῦ Ἐν κεφαλίδι βιβλίου ἥκω Τοῦ ποιῆσαι σου τὸ θέλημά ὁ Θεός
verses.transliteration: Tote eipon Idou gegraptai peri emou En kephalidi bibliou hēkō Tou poiēsai sou to thelēma ho Theos
verses.literal: Then I said Here I am it is written about Me in vvv [the] scroll I have come - to do Your - will - O God

verses.original: Ἀνώτερον λέγων ὅτι Θυσίας καὶ προσφορὰς καὶ ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ περὶ ἁμαρτίας οὐκ ἠθέλησας οὐδὲ εὐδόκησας αἵτινες προσφέρονται κατὰ νόμον
verses.transliteration: Anōteron legōn hoti Thysias kai prosphoras kai holokautōmata kai peri hamartias ouk ēthelēsas oude eudokēsas haitines prospherontai kata nomon
verses.literal: [ In the passage ] above He says - Sacrifices and offerings - burnt offerings and vvv sin [offerings] vvv You did not desire nor did You delight in [them] [although] they are offered according to [the] law

verses.original: τότε εἴρηκεν Ἰδοὺ ἥκω τοῦ ποιῆσαι σου τὸ θέλημά ἀναιρεῖ τὸ πρῶτον ἵνα στήσῃ τὸ δεύτερον
verses.transliteration: tote eirēken Idou hēkō tou poiēsai sou to thelēma anairei to prōton hina stēsē to deuteron
verses.literal: Then He adds Here I am I have come - to do Your - will He takes away the first to establish the second

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ θελήματι ἐσμὲν ἡγιασμένοι διὰ τῆς προσφορᾶς τοῦ σώματος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐφάπαξ
verses.transliteration: en hō thelēmati esmen hēgiasmenoi dia tēs prosphoras tou sōmatos Iēsou Christou ephapax
verses.literal: [And] by that will we have been sanctified through the sacrifice of the body of Jesus Christ once for all

verses.original: Καὶ μὲν καθ’ ἡμέραν πᾶς ἱερεὺς ἕστηκεν λειτουργῶν καὶ προσφέρων πολλάκις τὰς αὐτὰς θυσίας αἵτινες δύνανται οὐδέποτε περιελεῖν ἁμαρτίας
verses.transliteration: Kai men kath’ hēmeran pas hiereus hestēken leitourgōn kai prospherōn pollakis tas autas thysias haitines dynantai oudepote perielein hamartias
verses.literal: - - vvv Day after day every priest stands to minister and to offer again and again the same sacrifices which can never take away sins

verses.original: δὲ οὗτος προσενέγκας εἰς τὸ διηνεκὲς μίαν θυσίαν ὑπὲρ ἁμαρτιῶν ἐκάθισεν ἐν δεξιᾷ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: de houtos prosenenkas eis to diēnekes mian thysian hyper hamartiōn ekathisen en dexia tou Theou
verses.literal: But [when] this [Priest] had offered vvv vvv for all time one sacrifice for sins He sat down at [the] right hand - of God

verses.original: τὸ λοιπὸν ἐκδεχόμενος ἕως αὐτοῦ οἱ ἐχθροὶ τεθῶσιν ὑποπόδιον τῶν αὐτοῦ ποδῶν
verses.transliteration: to loipon ekdechomenos heōs autou hoi echthroi tethōsin hypopodion tōn autou podōn
verses.literal: vvv Since that time He waits for His - enemies to be made a footstool for His feet

verses.original: γὰρ μιᾷ προσφορᾷ τετελείωκεν εἰς τὸ διηνεκὲς τοὺς ἁγιαζομένους
verses.transliteration: gar mia prosphora teteleiōken eis to diēnekes tous hagiazomenous
verses.literal: because by a single offering He has made perfect for - all time those who are being sanctified

verses.original: δὲ τὸ τὸ Ἅγιον Πνεῦμα καὶ Μαρτυρεῖ ἡμῖν γὰρ μετὰ τὸ εἰρηκέναι
verses.transliteration: de to to Hagion Pneuma kai Martyrei hēmin gar meta to eirēkenai
verses.literal: - The - Holy Spirit also testifies to us {about this} - [First] - He says

verses.original: Αὕτη ἡ διαθήκη ἣν διαθήσομαι πρὸς αὐτοὺς μετὰ ἐκείνας τὰς ἡμέρας λέγει Κύριος διδοὺς μου νόμους ἐπὶ αὐτῶν καρδίας καὶ ἐπιγράψω αὐτούς ἐπὶ αὐτῶν τὴν διάνοιαν
verses.transliteration: Hautē hē diathēkē hēn diathēsomai pros autous meta ekeinas tas hēmeras legei Kyrios didous mou nomous epi autōn kardias kai epigrapsō autous epi autōn tēn dianoian
verses.literal: This [is] the covenant - I will make with them after those - days declares [the] Lord I will put My laws in their hearts and inscribe them on their - minds

verses.original: Καὶ αὐτῶν Τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν καὶ αὐτῶν τῶν ἀνομιῶν μνησθήσομαι οὐ μὴ ἔτι
verses.transliteration: Kai autōn Tōn hamartiōn kai autōn tōn anomiōn mnēsthēsomai ou mē eti
verses.literal: [Then He adds] Their - sins and - - lawless acts I will remember no . . . more

verses.original: δὲ Ὅπου τούτων ἄφεσις προσφορὰ περὶ ἁμαρτίας οὐκέτι
verses.transliteration: de Hopou toutōn aphesis prosphora peri hamartias ouketi
verses.literal: And where these have been forgiven an offering for sin [is] no longer [ needed ]

verses.original: οὖν ἀδελφοί Ἔχοντες παρρησίαν εἰς τὴν εἴσοδον τῶν ἁγίων ἐν τῷ αἵματι Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: oun adelphoi Echontes parrēsian eis tēn eisodon tōn hagiōn en tō haimati Iēsou
verses.literal: Therefore brothers [since] we have confidence to - enter the [Most] Holy Place by the blood of Jesus

verses.original: πρόσφατον καὶ ζῶσαν ὁδὸν ἣν ἐνεκαίνισεν ἡμῖν διὰ τοῦ καταπετάσματος τοῦτ’ ἔστιν αὐτοῦ τῆς σαρκὸς
verses.transliteration: prosphaton kai zōsan hodon hēn enekainisen hēmin dia tou katapetasmatos tout’ estin autou tēs sarkos
verses.literal: by [the] new and living way - opened for us through the curtain - - of His - body

verses.original: καὶ μέγαν ἱερέα ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai megan hierea epi ton oikon tou Theou
verses.literal: and [since we have] a great priest over the house - of God

verses.original: προσερχώμεθα μετὰ ἀληθινῆς καρδίας ἐν πληροφορίᾳ πίστεως τὰς καρδίας ῥεραντισμένοι ἀπὸ πονηρᾶς συνειδήσεως καὶ τὸ σῶμα λελουσμένοι καθαρῷ ὕδατι
verses.transliteration: proserchōmetha meta alēthinēs kardias en plērophoria pisteōs tas kardias rherantismenoi apo ponēras syneidēseōs kai to sōma lelousmenoi katharō hydati
verses.literal: let us draw near with a sincere heart in full assurance of faith {having} our hearts sprinkled to cleanse us from a guilty conscience and [our] bodies washed with pure water

verses.original: Κατέχωμεν ἀκλινῆ τὴν τῆς ἐλπίδος ὁμολογίαν γὰρ ὁ ἐπαγγειλάμενος πιστὸς
verses.transliteration: Katechōmen aklinē tēn tēs elpidos homologian gar ho epangeilamenos pistos
verses.literal: Let us hold resolutely to the - hope we profess for He who promised [is] faithful

verses.original: καὶ κατανοῶμεν εἰς παροξυσμὸν ἀλλήλους ἀγάπης καὶ καλῶν ἔργων
verses.transliteration: kai katanoōmen eis paroxysmon allēlous agapēs kai kalōn ergōn
verses.literal: And let us consider how to spur one another {on} to love and good deeds

verses.original: μὴ ἐγκαταλείποντες τὴν ἐπισυναγωγὴν ἑαυτῶν καθὼς τισίν ἔθος ἀλλὰ παρακαλοῦντες καὶ τοσούτῳ μᾶλλον ὅσῳ βλέπετε τὴν ἡμέραν ἐγγίζουσαν
verses.transliteration: mē enkataleipontes tēn episynagōgēn heautōn kathōs tisin ethos alla parakalountes kai tosoutō mallon hosō blepete tēn hēmeran engizousan
verses.literal: vvv Let us not neglect - meeting together . . . as some [have made a] habit but let us encourage [one another] and all [the] more as you see the Day approaching

verses.original: γὰρ ἡμῶν Ἑκουσίως ἁμαρτανόντων μετὰ τὸ λαβεῖν τὴν ἐπίγνωσιν τῆς ἀληθείας οὐκέτι θυσία περὶ ἁμαρτιῶν ἀπολείπεται
verses.transliteration: gar hēmōn Hekousiōs hamartanontōn meta to labein tēn epignōsin tēs alētheias ouketi thysia peri hamartiōn apoleipetai
verses.literal: - [If] we deliberately go on sinning after - we have received the knowledge of the truth no further sacrifice for sins remains

verses.original: δέ τις φοβερὰ ἐκδοχὴ κρίσεως καὶ ζῆλος πυρὸς μέλλοντος ἐσθίειν τοὺς ὑπεναντίους
verses.transliteration: de tis phobera ekdochē kriseōs kai zēlos pyros mellontos esthiein tous hypenantious
verses.literal: but only a fearful expectation of judgment and of raging fire that will consume [all] adversaries

verses.original: τις ἀθετήσας νόμον Μωϋσέως ἀποθνήσκει χωρὶς οἰκτιρμῶν ἐπὶ δυσὶν ἢ τρισὶν μάρτυσιν
verses.transliteration: tis athetēsas nomon Mōuseōs apothnēskei chōris oiktirmōn epi dysin ē trisin martysin
verses.literal: Anyone who rejected [the] law of Moses died without mercy on [the testimony of] two or three witnesses

verses.original: πόσῳ χείρονος δοκεῖτε ὁ ἀξιωθήσεται τιμωρίας καταπατήσας τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ ἡγησάμενος κοινὸν τὸ αἷμα τῆς διαθήκης ἐν ᾧ ἡγιάσθη καὶ ἐνυβρίσας τὸ Πνεῦμα τῆς χάριτος
verses.transliteration: posō cheironos dokeite ho axiōthēsetai timōrias katapatēsas ton Huion tou Theou kai hēgēsamenos koinon to haima tēs diathēkēs en hō hēgiasthē kai enybrisas to Pneuma tēs charitos
verses.literal: How much more severely do you think one deserves to be punished [who] has trampled on the Son - of God - vvv profaned the blood of the covenant vvv that sanctified him and insulted the Spirit - of grace

verses.original: γὰρ Οἴδαμεν τὸν εἰπόντα ἐκδίκησις Ἐμοὶ ἐγὼ ἀνταποδώσω καὶ πάλιν Κύριος Κρινεῖ αὐτοῦ τὸν λαὸν
verses.transliteration: gar Oidamen ton eiponta ekdikēsis Emoi egō antapodōsō kai palin Kyrios Krinei autou ton laon
verses.literal: For we know Him who said Vengeance [is] Mine I will repay and again [The] Lord will judge His - people

verses.original: φοβερὸν τὸ ἐμπεσεῖν εἰς χεῖρας ζῶντος Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: phoberon to empesein eis cheiras zōntos Theou
verses.literal: [It is] a fearful thing - to fall into [the] hands of [the] living God

verses.original: δὲ Ἀναμιμνῄσκεσθε τὰς πρότερον ἡμέρας φωτισθέντες ἐν αἷς ὑπεμείνατε πολλὴν ἄθλησιν παθημάτων
verses.transliteration: de Anamimnēskesthe tas proteron hēmeras phōtisthentes en hais hypemeinate pollēn athlēsin pathēmatōn
verses.literal: - Remember the early days that you were in the light In [those days] you endured a great conflict in the face of suffering

verses.original: τοῦτο μὲν θεατριζόμενοι τε ὀνειδισμοῖς καὶ θλίψεσιν δὲ τοῦτο γενηθέντες κοινωνοὶ τῶν οὕτως ἀναστρεφομένων
verses.transliteration: touto men theatrizomenoi te oneidismois kai thlipsesin de touto genēthentes koinōnoi tōn houtōs anastrephomenōn
verses.literal: Sometimes . . . you were publicly exposed - to ridicule and persecution - at other times you were partners with those who [were] so treated

verses.original: γὰρ καὶ συνεπαθήσατε τοῖς δεσμίοις καὶ μετὰ χαρᾶς προσεδέξασθε τὴν ἁρπαγὴν τῶν ὑμῶν ὑπαρχόντων γινώσκοντες ἑαυτοὺς ἔχειν κρείττονα καὶ μένουσαν ὕπαρξιν
verses.transliteration: gar kai synepathēsate tois desmiois kai meta charas prosedexasthe tēn harpagēn tōn hymōn hyparchontōn ginōskontes heautous echein kreittona kai menousan hyparxin
verses.literal: - - You sympathized with those in prison and vvv joyfully accepted the confiscation of your property knowing that you yourselves had a better and permanent possession

verses.original: οὖν Μὴ ἀποβάλητε ὑμῶν τὴν παρρησίαν ἥτις ἔχει μεγάλην μισθαποδοσίαν
verses.transliteration: oun Mē apobalēte hymōn tēn parrēsian hētis echei megalēn misthapodosian
verses.literal: So {do} not throw away your - confidence [it] holds a great reward

verses.original: γὰρ ἔχετε χρείαν ὑπομονῆς ἵνα ποιήσαντες τοῦ τὸ θέλημα Θεοῦ κομίσησθε τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν
verses.transliteration: gar echete chreian hypomonēs hina poiēsantes tou to thelēma Theou komisēsthe tēn epangelian
verses.literal: - You need to persevere so that after you have done - the will of God you will receive what He has promised

verses.original: γὰρ ἔτι ὅσον Μικρὸν ὅσον ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἥξει καὶ οὐ χρονίσει
verses.transliteration: gar eti hoson Mikron hoson ho erchomenos hēxei kai ou chronisei
verses.literal: For vvv In just a little while He who is coming will come and vvv will not delay

verses.original: δὲ μου δίκαιός ὁ ζήσεται ἐκ πίστεως καὶ ἐὰν ὑποστείληται μου ἡ ψυχή οὐκ εὐδοκεῖ ἐν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: de mou dikaios ho zēsetai ek pisteōs kai ean hyposteilētai mou hē psychē ouk eudokei en autō
verses.literal: But My righteous one will live by faith and if he shrinks back I . . . . . . {will take} no pleasure in him

verses.original: δὲ Ἡμεῖς ἐσμὲν οὐκ ὑποστολῆς εἰς ἀπώλειαν ἀλλὰ πίστεως εἰς περιποίησιν ψυχῆς
verses.transliteration: de Hēmeis esmen ouk hypostolēs eis apōleian alla pisteōs eis peripoiēsin psychēs
verses.literal: But we are not of [those who] shrink back [and] are destroyed but of [those who have] faith [and] preserve [their] souls
